title: Reject Incompatible Delivery Baselines in Saved Experiment Comparisons
body:
## Problem

Saved comparison validated seed, shot count, and target but could accept differing clubs, speeds, or lofts at an identical target.

## Acceptance Criteria

Require matching club, nominal delivery, numerical integration, and target radius. Permit the deliberately compared face variability, curve magnitude, and coupling mode. Write failing mismatch tests before the contract.

## Validation

tests/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/test_comparison.py

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
